sources.title: See each claim; this file's claims carry their own sources.

note: Claims for polities the boundary source does not name in any year, so there is nothing to carry from a neighbouring snapshot and an extent has to be stated.

claims.note: Cahokia and the American Bottom. The source draws Eastern North American hunter-gatherers over a city the Cahokia article puts at 15,000 to 20,000 people with some 120 earthworks, which is not a coarse label but a wrong one. The claim runs only 1050 to 1350, the life of the city: after that the valley belongs to the Chickasaw, Quapaw, Miami and Illinois, whom the source names and whom an earlier and wider version of this claim erased.
